principle: capabilities are discovered from runtime probes, not assumed from labels/manuals

semantics.success: evidence capability worked under recorded condition
semantics.failure: evidence this probe failed under recorded condition; not universal impossibility

repository_integration: discovery receipts can be committed into Sol-native repository lineage
limits: live external adapters must provide their own probes
this test does not prove availability of iOS signing, Codemagic, Grok, or Gemini
